arch._src: README.md and docs/DETAILS.md (section Allie 2.1: width, heads, experts, parameters, GFLOPs, one game's 1.29 GB of int8 weights, 14.3 ms a move); src/allie/model (moe.py, network.py, board.py); src/allie/data/vocab.py; its training run's configuration; demo: allie.lichess.api.Allie.analyze on the released Allie 2.1 (int8, CPU); Allie 2.0 (v20) only as the comparison's predecessor

why._src: the isoFLOP sweep's small models (256 experts with 12 active against 128 with 6; dense against MoE), not Allie 2.1 or 2.0

router._src: Allie 2.0's first attempt (starved) and big run (starved_after, overflow, floor); not Allie 2.1's: its run's worst layer logged a median of 0-4 starved experts, 20 at most, and its log-space gates need no floor

demo._src: allie.lichess.api.Allie.analyze, released Allie 2.1 (int8 CPU, the default Rust engine), time control 180+2; outputs: 1800 vs 1750, clocks 180, 180, 179 s; human: both players at each rating, no clocks

scaling._src: the 45-run isoFLOP sweep (24 MoE, 21 dense; main-evaluation CE) refit three ways (Chinchilla approaches 1-3); Allie 2.0 / 2.1 from the big runs; miss: the why-the-law-missed-Allie-2.0 study (backtests, law forms, decay-to-zero forks of Allie 2.0, eval and parameter-count checks); actual: Allie 2.1's final checkpoint on the main evaluation (bigrun-trajectory-v4) and its released weights (README, 1.2240); later: the Oct 17 refit's four law forms on September 2026 games, against Allie 2.1's released weights on them

search._src: Allie 2.1's shipped rule, src/allie/lichess/calibration.py (RULES, LADDER, COST, MARGIN), scored as the bot plays it (analysis/elo_strength/calib_unified.py; release-2.1/calib-fit win21-sept and its plot json, the README figure's); cells: September 2026 games, none in the fit; raw_elo and elo: mean of the accuracy and blunder-rate Elo gaps against the humans; ce: human-move CE minus the raw policy's, nats; miss: outside the noise at 95% on accuracy or blunder rate; leaves: the median of the rungs the bot's think-time draws give, at COST; raw and shipped: per time control, the mean gap and the debiased RMS Elo of calib_unified.report; tests: DETAILS' Calibrated play. sweep: research on annealed Allie 2.0 only, the search sweep of Oct 3-5, 2026 (coverage_elo: its per-cell table before the sweep, classical 2400 and 2600 at 256 simulations; rows: leaves to reach human accuracy with CE below raw on 1,000 dev positions per cell; holdout: classical 2600 on 4,000 positions outside dev). live: the bot's live config and DETAILS' four-game test

schematic._note: illustrative numbers for the explanatory beats, not measurements
